setup: "Receive Message" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value supportflowCompanyInfo: supportflow company info (was the n8n environment variable SUPPORTFLOW_COMPANY_INFO). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value supportflowCompanyName: supportflow company name (was the n8n environment variable SUPPORTFLOW_COMPANY_NAME). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value supportflowSheetId: supportflow sheet id (was the n8n environment variable SUPPORTFLOW_SHEET_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, llm_system_aae36c0f78.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /supportflow-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Validate Input" (code.require): Allowlisted require() calls were rewritten or dropped for Transform (no module system).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## SupportFlow Lite - Simple AI Bot

No vector database needed.
Uses company info from environment variable.

Best for: Small businesses, MVPs, testing.
Setup: 2 minutes (just OpenAI + Sheets).

Upgrade to Main workflow when you
need RAG-powered knowledge base.
